<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a login for SFTP, FTPS, the web portal and the S3-compatible endpoint.

Everything is optional. With an empty body you get a generated name, a generated password that
satisfies your organization's password policy, a home directory of `/home/{UserName}`, and
`Permission: none`: connectable, but able to see nothing. In practice you almost always want to
set `Permission`, or give the credential virtual folders with `HomeDirectoryDetails`.

The response includes the password. You can read it again later with the get or list
endpoints, since we store it, but capture it now if you are handing it to someone.

Counts against your plan's credential limit.
